mapper.select: /* PushOutboxMapper.selectPendingForSend */ SELECT O.NOTI_ID AS notiId , O.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , O.TARGET_USER_CD AS targetUserCd , O.NOTI_TYPE AS notiType , O.TITLE AS title , O.BODY AS body , O.DATA_PAYLOAD AS dataPayload , O.RETRY_CNT AS retryCnt FROM TB_NOTI_OUTBOX O WHERE O.SEND_STATUS = 'PENDING' AND O.DEL_YN = 'N' AND O.RETRY_CNT < #{maxRetry} ORDER BY O.INSERT_DATE ASC LIMIT #{batchSize}
